title: the restart skill's proof reaches no device
intention: The /restart skill's proof measures that its WATCHME probe is armed through the WATCHME gate's own public measure, without importing the cc device's code, so build_inspector's encapsulation_holds reads no skills/restart file crossing into a device.
why: build_inspector cc, 2026-11-05 after f5c334da752a's build: encapsulation_holds reds cc at skills/restart/proofs/test_restart_selector.py:126, importlib.import_module('cairn.devices.cc.probes.a_restart_leaves_a_slate_behind_it'), reason into_device. It is cc's last encapsulation red, and f5c334da752a's PROVED gate runs cc's whole build_inspector, so that voyage cannot close while it stands.
traces_to: RULE 1 (nothing outside a device reaches into its code, skills included) and Law 4 (encapsulation_holds is the physics). Parent concept piece 8e3474a6ae43 (rule-1-encapsulation); sibling f5c334da752a.
how: Edit one proof and add one; no production code. Tooth (i) of the selector proof asks the WATCHME gate's public measure cairn.tools.base.watchme_spec.armed_error whether the probe berth is armed, instead of importing the cc probe module; a Probe cannot be built without a why (cairn/tools/base/probe.py:298), so armed_error's PROBE/carry/enough checks keep all four of the old tooth's. Decisions D1-D4 carry the exact shape.
falsifier: Done when (1) PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector cc lists no encapsulation_holds finding; (2) skills/restart/proofs/test_restart_proof_reaches_no_device.py and skills/restart/proofs/test_restart_selector.py are green twice under bin/cairn test and the hollow reading (the selector proof reverted) reds the new proof; (3) _probe_armed reds a fixture berth whose PROBE has no enough and one with no PROBE. WRONG INTENT if armed_error passes a berth the old import-based tooth would have refused.

decisions.text: D1: WHERE. Edit skills/restart/proofs/test_restart_selector.py; add skills/restart/proofs/test_restart_proof_reaches_no_device.py. Nothing outside skills/restart/proofs/ changes. The cc probe at cairn/devices/cc/probes/a_restart_leaves_a_slate_behind_it.py is read, never edited.

D2: THE CHECK. In skills/restart/proofs/test_restart_selector.py, after the PROVES line, add module-level `_PROBE_BERTH = "cairn/devices/cc/probes/a_restart_leaves_a_slate_behind_it.py"` and `def _probe_armed(berth=_PROBE_BERTH):` with docstring 'The WATCHME gate's own measure of this skill's probe, by berth path: None when armed, else the refusal (RULE 1, ticket e9c29538b7fb).' whose body is `from cairn.tools.base.watchme_spec import armed_error` then `return armed_error({"probe": str(berth)}, root=_ROOT)`. Tooth (i)'s block — the try/except importing cairn.devices.cc.probes.a_restart_leaves_a_slate_behind_it and cairn.tools.base.probe.Probe, `pr = probe_mod.PROBE`, and the isinstance/carry/enough/why assert — is replaced by `err = _probe_armed()` and `assert err is None, f"(i) the WATCHME probe is not armed: {err}"`; the following print line stays. The module docstring's '(i) the WATCHME probe is a Probe carrying both carry and enough' becomes '(i) the WATCHME gate's armed_error passes the probe's berth (a Probe carrying why, carry and enough)'. `import importlib` stays (the selector uses it).

D3: THE PROOF. skills/restart/proofs/test_restart_proof_reaches_no_device.py: _SKILL = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]; _ROOT = _SKILL.parents[1] on sys.path. PROVES = {'e9c29538b7fb': {'1': 'test_no_restart_file_reaches_a_device', '2': 'test_the_armed_check_reds_an_unarmed_berth', '3': 'test_the_armed_check_passes_the_real_probe'}}. The selector proof is loaded INSIDE each tooth by importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('_restart_selector_proof', _SKILL / 'proofs' / 'test_restart_selector.py') (call-time binding). Tooth 1: ast-parse every *.py under skills/restart/ (skip __pycache__); collect level-0 ImportFrom.module and Import names, and the first string-constant argument of any call whose function is named import_module (ast.Name or ast.Attribute attr), that start with 'cairn.devices.'; assert the list is empty, naming file:line. Tooth 2: a fixture folder from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir('testing-e9c29538b7fb-'); unarmed.py = the real berth's text plus '
import dataclasses
PROBE = dataclasses.replace(PROBE, enough=None)
'; noprobe.py = 'X = 1
'; assert mod._probe_armed(folder / name) is a non-empty str for both, and that the unarmed one's text contains 'enough'. Tooth 3: mod._probe_armed() is None. `if __name__ == '__main__':` runs every test_ function, prints PASS/FAIL per tooth, catches Exception, exits 1 on any failure.

D4: RUN AND HOLLOW. Both proofs run under bin/cairn test twice, green. The hollow reading reverts skills/restart/proofs/test_restart_selector.py to its pre-build bytes: tooth 1 reds (the import_module literal returns) and teeth 2 and 3 red (no _probe_armed attribute). Then build_inspector cc must list no encapsulation_holds finding — the verdict records that run; f5c334da752a's PROVED crossing follows.
